upstream_diagnostics.note: Separate-process mock accept/handle. Pair with [clawql-upstream-fetch] on ClawQL stderr when CLAWQL_UPSTREAM_FETCH_DIAG=1. On Node 22 http.globalAgent.keepAlive defaults true — tcp_connects≈1 is expected even without CLAWQL_UPSTREAM_KEEPALIVE.

runtime_flags.note: Applied evenly to all ClawQL arms (stdio / Streamable HTTP / gRPC). Override with CLAWQL_NODE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_MB=0 or CLAWQL_BUN_SMOL=0 for defaults-only. category_win: Category story: most efficient governed gateway — multi-turn I/O tokens with equal task success.
1. Primary model — classic Layer1 once + Σ Layer2 (clients that cache tools/list).
2. Input side — ClawQL Layer1 is search+execute only; aggregators pay the full fat tools/list once.
3. Output side — ClawQL gateway fields/where projection; Executor measured path is full payload pass-through.
4. Re-list-every-turn is secondary sensitivity only (most clients cache; lazy clients shrink aggregators further).
5. Settled: do not label a hand-written slim-return program as Executor (Both Sides of Context Compression).
Measured vs Executor @N=12: classic 4.33× (fat return — matches live Layer 2 pass-through; Layer1 schema still smaller).
Vs direct HTTP (no MCP): ClawQL saves ~22612 tokens @N=12 (projection + search schemas vs fat bodies); flow e2e p50 delta ≈ +15.1 ms vs raw HTTP.
RSS is a loss among serious arms — admit or fix before memory claims.
honesty: Fat catalog equal-arm: N MCP tools mirrored as N OpenAPI operationIds.
PRIMARY tokens: classic Layer1_once + sum(Layer2) with deterministic task_success (tokens from flow 1; spot-stable).
MT_ITERS=10000: each arm completes that many full 12-turn flows on one warm connection.
Also reports flow e2e + per-turn latency percentiles and RSS (do not drop these for publish).
direct: no MCP gateway — raw HTTP fat catalog; Layer1=0. Prices token savings vs latency/RSS tax of each gateway.
SECONDARY: tools_list_every_turn — measured once on flow 1; most clients cache ListTools.
Executor Layer2 is fat JSON — matches measured live path (executor-cmp-001 / Both Sides post). No gateway fields.
Do not publish a hand-written slim-return program as Executor.
clawql_bun: same dist/server.js as clawql; only JS runtime changes.
executor + executor_v2 share the same runExecutorArm loop and fat fixture (discovery=0).
Executor 2 removed stdio MCP (`executor mcp` is v1-only) — product transport is HTTP; harness equalization is the shared loop, not pretending v2 has stdio.
Do not compare Executor v2 latency/RSS to ClawQL Bun stdio as same-topology. Tokens remain comparable.
ClawQL transport matrix: clawql/clawql_bun (stdio), clawql_http/clawql_http_bun (Streamable HTTP), clawql_grpc/clawql_grpc_bun (gRPC MCP).
All Streamable HTTP clients skip standalone GET SSE (fetch returns 405) — same filter for ClawQL HTTP, Executor v2, MCPJungle, agentgateway.
ClawQL HTTP server also sets CLAWQL_MCP_DISABLE_STANDALONE_SSE=1; client filter equalizes peers that would otherwise open SSE.
gRPC is ClawQL-only on this board — Executor / MCPJungle / agentgateway have no gRPC MCP peer here.
RUNTIME FLAGS (even across all ClawQL arms): Node --max-old-space-size=512; Bun --smol. See config.runtime_flags. Memory deltas vs older default-heap boards partly reflect these knobs.

gRPC Layer1 is 16 tokens below stdio/HTTP (281 vs 297): protobuf Tool omits SDK execution.taskSupport=forbidden on search+execute. Envelope-only — CallTool result bodies match; not a dropped content field.
RPCs/turn: ClawQL = 2 (search+execute); peers = 1. Publish ms/call = turn_p50 / rpcs_per_turn. Session latency gap is mostly the second call, which buys projection token savings.
LATENCY CLAIMS (HTTP-to-HTTP): per-call overhead on par with Go/Rust gateways; ClawQL Bun HTTP median ~2.3× agentgateway and >2× faster than Executor v2. Do not claim '3×–9× tighter tail'.
Publish board must be one interleaved run of every arm — do not stitch rows from separate solo runs (p999 drifts across sessions).
VIDEO: latency section uses same-transport HTTP numbers only (ClawQL HTTP vs Executor v2 / MCPJungle / agentgateway). Replace '3× to 9× tighter tail' with per-call parity + >2× vs Executor v2.
NEXT WIN: skip search when the agent already knows the operation (execute by ID) — halves remaining latency gap and cuts discovery tokens on repeat turns.
Executor discovery=0 on both versions (harness-authored execute). ClawQL charges search each turn.
ContextForge/MetaMCP off publish board by default.
Pets interleaved p999 board remains gateway-multi-cmp-10k.json / ts7-*-10k.json.
RSS is a loss among serious arms — admit plainly. Classify Executor v2 climb via rss_trend before 'Nx heavier' headlines.
p999 STATUS: isolated_remeasure — republished under isolated harness (taskset + separate mock). Tails from this board are the gateways' own under the recorded core_layout — still host-bound.
CORE LAYOUT: enabled=true nproc=4 mock=0 gateway=1-2 client=3. Mock is a separate process (not the client event loop).
MT_UPSTREAM_LATENCY_MS unset — mock responds ASAP (isolation board). Optional 20-100ms arm after tails republish.
